|lore=Feisty. Loyal. Heroic. Insecure. Rebel spy. Excels at trouble. Incorrigible counterpart of a mindless philosopher. Has picked up a slight flutter. A bit eccentric.
|game_text=While aboard a starfighter, adds 2 to power, maneuver, and hyperspeed. While present with a Scomp link, adds one [Light Side] icon here. Immune to Fire Extinguisher and Restraining Bolt.

|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 4) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo) (V) (ALT) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V1-L-r2d2_ai-2023-12-02.png]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V1-L-r2d2_ai-2023-12-02-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V1-L-r2d2_ai-2022-08-30.png]], 30 August 2022) → [[File:V1-L-r2d2_ai-2023-12-02-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V1-L-r2d2_ai-2023-12-02.png]], 2 December 2023). '''Errata mark:''' the image prints “E2”, but this is errata 1 in release order; the mark is recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo) (V) (ALT)]]): PC card image uploaded 30 August 2022<ref name="img-r2d2_ai3515e91">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/r2d2_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/3515e91b0f5636658fca65b3ec5bc7d79d105a8f commit 3515e91] (30 August 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/r2d2_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. Document: errata mark “E2”; bottom margin “R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo)”. Text: “While aboard a starfighter, adds 2 to power, maneuver, and hyperspeed. While present with a Scomp link, adds one [Light Side] icon here. Immune to Fire Extinguisher and Restraining Bolt.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC card image uploaded 2 December 2023<ref name="img-r2d2_ai509151e">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/r2d2_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/509151e2a81ba946389cdd7b3468137a459c5ad5 commit 509151e] (2 December 2023); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/r2d2_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' a small logo now prints at bottom right, just left of “(AI)”; the words are unchanged; the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E2”; bottom margin “R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo)”. Text: “While aboard a starfighter, adds 2 to power, maneuver, and hyperspeed. While present with a Scomp link, adds one [Light Side] icon here. Immune to Fire Extinguisher and Restraining Bolt.”
* '''PC-E2''' ([[R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo) (V) (ALT) (Errata 2)]]): PC card image uploaded 30 December 2024<ref name="img-r2d2_ai9d2c01e">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/r2d2_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/9d2c01ed1603f793dc8a0569c99d4b544378da9b commit 9d2c01e] (30 December 2024); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/r2d2_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' “Side] icon here. Immune to Fire” → “Side] icon here and, during battles at same and related related interior sites, once per turn may use 1 Force to subtract”; “Immune to Fire Extinguisher and Restraining Bolt.” → “Force to subtract 1 from a just drawn destiny.”; the errata mark “E2” → “E3”. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E3”; bottom margin “R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo)”. Text: “While aboard a starfighter, adds 2 to power, maneuver, and hyperspeed. While present with a Scomp link, adds one [Light Side] icon here and, during battles at same and related related interior sites, once per turn may use 1 Force to subtract 1 from a just drawn destiny.”
* '''PC-E3''' ([[R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo) (V) (ALT) (Errata 3)]]): PC card image uploaded 31 December 2024<ref name="img-r2d2_aif0e499f">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/r2d2_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/f0e499fbdb939727ddfad1dbd10bf65443919c4f commit f0e499f] (31 December 2024); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/r2d2_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E3”; bottom margin “R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo)”. It is the current image (the same file as the wiki's existing image). Text: “While aboard a starfighter, adds 2 to power, maneuver, and hyperspeed.
